summary: The agent delivers a well-structured solution featuring a 3-model ensemble and grid-search weight optimization. However, it applies group-wise feature engineering on the full training set before cross-validation, leaking validation fold statistics into the training folds. Additionally, it relies entirely on the models to handle missing original features and fails to declare integer-encoded categorical features to the tree models, causing them to be treated as continuous variables.
